description: Fetch each lead's website and extract 50+ fields: business email, social profiles, CMS, CRM, email-marketing platform, chat widget, booking system, ad pixels, analytics, schema, SSL, page load, domain age, mail host, and AI-crawler policy. Costs one token per five businesses, on any business you hold, and does not enroll it. The emails it finds are not checked: verify_emails does that, 3 tokens per verified address. To have businesses re-read every month, use enroll_leads. Runs in the background, returns a job id, poll it with get_job_status. Every field follows the three-state contract: a value, a confirmed absence, or unknown.

force.description: Re-enrich rows that already have data (use to refresh stale enrichment). Default false.
